LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.GearAvailabl: Scales only existing beneficial offsets for curated work, movement, medical, social or psyfocus stats. Zero offsets and penalties stay unchanged; native stat limits still apply.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NoContributi: No supported beneficial definition offset in this group. Unknown stats, trait-only bonuses and existing native or custom quality-aware stat parts are left unchanged.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.Conflict: The native consumer is missing or another mod intercepts it. This adapter leaves the consumer unchanged to avoid duplicate scaling.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NativeCurve: The stat already has a native quality curve or custom worker/part. Its existing provider keeps control.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.NotApplicabl: This item does not use a supported native consumer. Turret gun definitions use turret cooldown only and are excluded from both weapon cooldown effects.
LanguageData.QEverything.EquipmentCombat.CombatAvaila: Uses the actual weapon cooldown, native turret burst cooldown or damaging-trap stat. Native attack damage, accuracy, cooldown factors and trap variance remain in control.
